posts.text: Since Nyjer Morgan "tickled" a single up the middle for the first postseason walkoff in franchise history, the Brewers have had two more. And T Plush threw ceremonial first pitches at both! Here’s what he had to say about that. Entertaining, as always. www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
